_experiment.description: Omega sample size sensitivity — B=1000. Intermediate sample count between the noisy B=100 case and the baseline B=10000. Expect the sparsity curve to be slightly noisier than the baseline but substantially better than B=100.
literature: Thesis ch_manifold: d_W(w,w') = E_{x~U(Omega)}[||F(w)(x) - F(w')(x)||^2] — the expectation is approximated by Monte Carlo; this experiment characterises the approximation error
